compact.purpose: Remove redundant requested-capacity word and derive it from admitted bytes

windowfixed.purpose: Fixed 4 MiB window lease metadata only, no per-symbol change

rawfixed.purpose: Raw histogram Vec combined with fixed-size window lease; not selected

interpretation.synchronization: No reserve calls or lease drops occur on the legacy photo route; synchronization and per-element reservation cannot explain the measured legacy slowdown. 100 explicit maps make 100 reservations; 100 windows plus their histogram map make 101, with matched drops.
interpretation.negative_controls: Capacity-check-only, compact wrapper metadata alone and fixed-window metadata alone do not remove the photo regression. The combined fixed-window variant is also inferior to raw histogram Vec alone.
interpretation.selected_change: Keep histogram hot storage as raw Vec and store its non-cloneable lease separately, freeing Vec before lease. Histogram size is 176 ->168 bytes on this host; reader72 and standalone wrapper48 stay unchanged. Size reduction alone is not an established cause: compact-size control does not recover performance. Evidence supports representation/code-generation interaction; no specific instruction-level bottleneck is claimed.
interpretation.simple: Earlier roughly3% simple-case slowdown does not consistently reproduce under controlled builds and A/A controls.
interpretation.qualification: The original photo regression is absent in the final measured ordinary cases after the storage change. This is not decoder-wide or platform-wide performance qualification.

ordering_correction: The earlier four-condition pilot reversed every other block, which did not balance positions for even condition counts. That pilot is retained locally and excluded from final qualification. Full-cycle balancing and --check-order cover 4, 5, 8 and 3 conditions.
